one_sentence_story: Melzack and Wall proved in 1965 that pain isn't a straight alarm wire to the head — it passes through a biological 'gate' in the spinal cord that fast touch signals (like rubbing a bumped shin) and calm brain signals can physically Dial down.
so_what_for_you: Use both halves of the gate: pair gentle physical touch, warmth, or movement (fast A-beta fibers) with calm breathing and focused engagement (descending brain control) instead of tensing in panic.
